title: The Nickname You Actually Like
youtube_title: The Nickname You Actually Like | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Yuri notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a name said the way you had asked, the full way. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Yuri does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
